import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
p='disease.samples.q1.tsv'
df=pd.read_csv(p,sep='\\t',index_col=0)
X=df.values.T
print('samples', df.columns.tolist())
print('log10 total', np.log10(X.sum(axis=1)))
# PCA on log1p standardized
Y=np.log1p(X)
# Use top variable genes maybe
var=Y.var(axis=0)
for k in [100,500,1000,3000,10000]:
    idx=np.argsort(var)[::-1][:k]
    Z=StandardScaler().fit_transform(Y[:,idx])
    pc=PCA(n_components=2).fit_transform(Z)
    print('\\nk',k,'var explained', PCA(n_components=2).fit(Z).explained_variance_ratio_)
    for s,(a,b) in zip(df.columns,pc):
        print(f'{s}: {a:.4f} {b:.4f}')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
p='disease.samples.q1.tsv'
df=pd.read_csv(p,sep='\\t',index_col=0)
A=['Sample_2','Sample_3','Sample_5','Sample_7']
B=['Sample_1','Sample_4','Sample_6','Sample_8','Sample_9']
X=df.values
meanA=np.log1p(X[:, [df.columns.get_loc(c) for c in A]]).mean(axis=1)
meanB=np.log1p(X[:, [df.columns.get_loc(c) for c in B]]).mean(axis=1)
lfc=meanA-meanB
# avg exp
avg=(meanA+meanB)/2
# t-test
from scipy import stats
pv=[]
for i in range(X.shape[0]):
    a=np.log1p(X[i,[df.columns.get_loc(c) for c in A]])
    b=np.log1p(X[i,[df.columns.get_loc(c) for c in B]])
    _,p=stats.ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=False)
    pv.append(p if np.isfinite(p) else 1)
pv=np.array(pv)
q=pd.Series(pv).rank()/len(pv)*1 # pseudo
out=pd.DataFrame({'gene':df.index,'meanA':meanA,'meanB':meanB,'lfc':lfc,'p':pv})
print('Up in A (putative disease if A):')
print(out.nsmallest(50,'p').sort_values('lfc',ascending=False).head(50)[['gene','meanA','meanB','lfc','p']].to_string(index=False))
print('\\nUp in B:')
print(out.nsmallest(50,'p').sort_values('lfc',ascending=True).head(50)[['gene','meanA','meanB','lfc','p']].to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, fcluster
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
p='disease.samples.q1.tsv'; df=pd.read_csv(p,sep='\\t',index_col=0)
X=np.log1p(df.values.T)
# var top 2000
idx=np.argsort(X.var(axis=0))[::-1][:2000]
Z=linkage(X[:,idx], method='ward')
for k in [2,3]:
    labels=fcluster(Z,k,criterion='maxclust')
    print(k, {c: df.columns[labels==c].tolist() for c in np.unique(labels)})
# correlations
C=np.corrcoef(X)
print('corr matrix sample labels', df.columns.tolist())
print(np.round(C,3))
PY"
